title: Provide current task commands without changing frozen entry points
body:
The new `choose_current_research_task.py` CLI gives all 16 generic orientation cards the current selected-baseline command. The emitted command passes on the admitted [PR4610](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4610) certificate; the old command reproduces `KeyError: 'bit_lower'`. This is a tooling repair. The complete kappa calculation and selected frontier are unchanged.

The [implementation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/69556bd8cf0125c4eed84d547ad6a222993797d8/scripts/choose_current_research_task.py), [regression controls](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/69556bd8cf0125c4eed84d547ad6a222993797d8/tests/test_research_current_assignment.py) and [contract note](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/69556bd8cf0125c4eed84d547ad6a222993797d8/docs/research/selected-baseline.md) show the exact boundary. Only the literal generic command is resolved. Each affected suggestion exposes its unchanged original entry as `catalog_first_step` and an explicit resolution record. The historical picker script, catalogue bytes, pure selection result, package `original_card`, task, method, scope key, scientific commands and acceptance gates are preserved. The new entry point delegates arguments to the frozen picker CLI and resolves its JSON output. Help and error status/text pass through. AGENTS.md and the standing procedure direct new work to this entry point; the root guide remains frozen because two packages use it at runtime. Missing or deleted current helpers fail; deliberate HEAD-matching sparse omissions are reported for materialization.

Base is `1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4` ([selected record](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4/certificates/selected-result.json)). This closes the emitted generic-command part of the [scoped handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4458#discussioncomment-19154161). [PR4906](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4906) documented 57 catalogue runtime consumers and repaired the standing procedure. [PR5359](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5359) supplies a separate authenticated historical complex-ceiling replay; its scientific command is outside this change.

With the selected source closure materialized, run:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/choose_current_research_task.py --seed 00000000000000000000000000000000 --task portable-replay
python3 -B scripts/research_selected_baseline.py
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_current_assignment.py
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_coordination.py
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_selected_baseline.py
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_onboarding.py
```

Expected: current and original first steps are both visible; baseline status is `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY`; tests report `OK`. Local evidence: all 22 historical/current assignment tests pass normally and under optimized Python 3.12.13; nine coordination, 13 baseline and all 27 Python 3.12 onboarding tests also pass. The current tests include exact child help/error propagation and a byte-exact before/after comparison of historical CLI output. The actual emitted command was executed and returns selected kappa `15108879/5000000000`. The replay planner on the committed diff selects zero research packages, and `git diff --check` passes.

The initial hosted run exposed an additional frozen consumer of the picker script and failed on that package's pre-existing selected-record drift. The final design preserves that script and both pinned root-guide consumers. It does not repin or modify the historical package.

This does not make every historical scientific card current. Scientific input migration, a current helper-inventory law, native replay, full supplier, Lean and Docker verification remain outside this repair. Source-binding success is not theorem acceptance. Full-history replay was not run in the shallow checkout.

Credit Mihir Srivastava for the migration handoffs and selected-baseline successor, Douglas Colkitt and the retained picker/source-checker contributors, and [PR3725](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3725) for the frozen-receipt precedent. New CLI resolution and tests: Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. No independent human review is claimed.
